svg.title: One RETRIEVE job, stage by stage
svg.desc: Pecos example: retrieving the payload on T17 to bay B21. The map numbers match the events, and the three bands show the event DAG after expansion, tray assignment and AGV assignment.
svg.metadata: ["The request: one TYPE_RETRIEVE job for the payload on T17. Bay B21 is READY_TO_INSERT and still holds the empty tray T21; AGV-1 is idle at W26. No events exist yet.", "Job expansion (PlanRetrieveJob) writes the intent as four events: switch B21 to TO_RETRIEVE, move T21 out of the bay (destination unknown), bring T17 into B21, then PROCESS_RETRIEVE.", "Tray assignment gives T21 a destination: P23. Event 1 becomes concrete; the other job events are unchanged.", "Tray assignment also finds blocker T15 on T17's critical path and inserts event 4 (T15 -> P19). T17's move into the bay now waits for it.", "AGV assignment wraps every TrayMove in move -> lift -> carry -> lower. In this order AGV-1 first drives to P15 and moves the blocker T15 to P19. The dashed arrow previews its first drive.", "Next AGV-1 drives to B21 and moves T21 to P23. An AddDepsAfterAmiga edge makes lifting T21 wait for the bay's TO_RETRIEVE transition (event 0).", "Finally AGV-1 fetches T17 at P17 and carries it into B21; after the lower, AddDepsAfterAmiga lets PROCESS_RETRIEVE (event 3) start. The DAG is now ready for Reduce() and the sanity check.", "Playing the plan: AGV-1 drives from W26 to P15 and stops under the blocker T15 (first row of band 3).", "AGV-1 lifts T15, carries it to the free stall P19 and lowers it (event 4). P15 is now free.", "Meanwhile B21 has switched to READY_TO_RETRIEVE (event 0). AGV-1 drives P19 -> W18 -> W22 -> W41 into the bay, under the empty tray T21.", "AGV-1 lifts T21 (this lift waited for event 0), carries it to P23 and lowers it (event 1).", "AGV-1 drives from P23 to P17, through the stall P15 that T15 has left, and stops under T17.", "AGV-1 lifts T17 with the car, carries it into B21 and lowers it (event 2). PROCESS_RETRIEVE (event 3) hands the car to the customer. Every tray and the AGV are where the plan leaves them."]
